blender.label: Blender

workflows.Start a new project: Ctrl+N then choose New General File; the scene resets to the default cube.
workflows.Name the project: Ctrl+Shift+S (Save As), type the name in the file name field, then Enter.
workflows.Add object: Shift+A -> Mesh -> UV Sphere for a sphere.
workflows.Add a sphere: Shift+A -> Mesh -> UV Sphere, or Shift+F4 for the Python console: bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add().
workflows.Move object: G then X/Y/Z to constrain axis.
workflows.Delete the default cube: Select the cube in the Outliner, press X and confirm; or in the Python console (Shift+F4): bpy.data.objects.remove(bpy.data.objects['Cube'], do_unlink=True).
workflows.Open shader editor: Switch an area to Shading workspace.

blender.hint: Prefer keyboard shortcuts; Blender's viewport is keyboard-driven.

davinci resolve.label: DaVinci Resolve

workflows.Import media: Ctrl+I, then drag clips to the timeline.

davinci resolve.hint: Use Spacebar to play, S to split, Ctrl+B to add edits; avoid dragging when a hotkey exists.

vs code.label: VS Code
vs code.hint: Use the Command Palette (Ctrl+Shift+P) for almost any command.

file explorer.label: File Manager

workflows.Open location: Ctrl+L (Windows/Linux) or Cmd+Shift+G (macOS), then type path.
workflows.Delete: Delete (to Recycle Bin); Shift+Delete permanently (needs confirmation).

file explorer.hint: Use the location bar (Ctrl+L) to jump directly to paths instead of clicking through folders.

browser.label: Web Browser
browser.hint: Use Ctrl+L to navigate directly to URLs.
